decisions.reason: The button pull-up decision does not alter the touch inputs. The source's separate touch-specific clause is already captured by a same-message MODIFY.
The button pull-up decision does not alter the PIR interface. The source's separate PIR-specific clause is already captured by a same-message MODIFY.
R16, R17, and R18 govern the GPIO buttons and slide switch, not the separate J_RESET input that connects EN to GND.
The panel-control bias change does not modify the sensor-board connector matrix.
The backlight's GPIO-controlled switch and supply jumper are unrelated to the R16–R18 panel-input pull-ups.
The panel-input electrical configuration does not change the integrated board's sensor connectors.
The SPS30 SEL-to-GND I2C-mode selection is independent of the panel button and switch pull-ups.
Changing panel GPIO bias resistors does not change sensor voltage compatibility or the level-shifter policy.
The addressable LED supply and data interface are unaffected by the panel-control input configuration.
The R16–R18 pull-up decision does not change the LED array board's composition or selected LED part.
The passive buzzer specification is electrically and functionally independent of the panel GPIO inputs.
The reference to connector pin 1 concerns the panel-control connectors, not the interboard power connector or its pin-order rule.
